name: Cold cabinet door
notes: N1110: the second wording of attention_sab_relay, chosen per night by FS47Attention::SabScript (same beats and timing, other thoughts and trace text).

beats.text: PRINTER / REMOTE LINK LOST. JUNCTION CABINET TEMP 26 F.
The cabinet door is cold to the touch. It should be warm in here.
At {clock} one antenna dropped its remote link, and the rack printer logged its junction cabinet at 26 degrees. The cabinet door was cold and beaded with frost.
Two of the tubes overhead are dead. I can buy a pair at the Caliche shop counter.
